semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides optical components and measurement systems that are relevant for semiconductor inspection and measurement processes.
summary: Grand Unified Optics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in optical components and measurement systems, including spectrometers and thermal sensing equipment, which are essential for semiconductor inspection and quality control. They offer a range of high-quality optical products and customized services to support the semiconductor manufacturing process.

regional_presence.China: The company has a strong presence with offices and production bases in multiple cities including Beijing, Tai'an, Shenzhen, Changchun, and Chongqing.
